chapter: Portraits from Hemphill to Getz, and the bebop question
title: Getz's 'Early Autumn' solo in DownBeat, and 'The Girl from Ipanema'
summary: Horace recalls Sharon Pease printing Getz's 'Early Autumn' solo and Horace's own 'Ginger Bell' piano part in DownBeat, and Getz's later bossa nova records.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: " Early Autumn." " Early Autumn." It was Woody Herman, with Woody Herman.

"Early Autumn" -- that thing was (Inaudible) published, that. Do you remember a guy that used to write for the DownBeat, the musical column of Chicago. He was connected with (inaudible) from named Sharon Pease?
Oh, yes. Yeah, I remember.
Well, he (Inaudible) and I are great friends.
Oh, really?
Yes. In fact, he was the one that published my piano part in one of his reports for DownBeat
of "Ginger Bell," one of my originals I recorded. Sharon Pease printed his solo, the guy who we're talking about --
Stan Getz.
Stan Getz -- printed his solo of "Early Autumn."
Of "Early Autumn."
And it helped a lot of musicians.
Sure.
I've got that old DownBeat right somewhere in the house --
Do you?
-- and it was just like he played it, man, and it was hard to take off.
I played that in class just last night.
Is that right?
Yeah.
That's a beautiful thing.
Oh, yeah. That's Ralph Burns.

Right. So Stan was playing just like that, when he was with me, see what I mean? Oh -- so I said, here's a guy that's going on, man. He's made a reputation, and, of course, "The Girl from Ipnema," with this girl that played the guitar -- what was her name? She played the guitar, I'm pretty sure, on this recording Stan made, "The Girl from
"Ipqnema."
I -- that was Carlos Jobim.
Was it Carlos?
Well, it's piece, I believe, and I don't know who was doing the guitar, when I come to think about it.

This girl guitarist -- terrific, and she made a lot of things with Stan. I can't think of her name. But anyhow, he did a great thing when he did "Ipqnema" too, you know, and what's this other thing that Stan made that was so popular that all the little guys like -- ta--ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-t-a-ta-te--ta-ta --
It's another piece like "Girl from" -- I can think of the chord changes and the whole --
Slightly out of tune --
